name: Pizza Pasta Bowls
intro_html: All the fun of pizza night, none of the delivery fee. Turkey pepperoni, high-protein rotini, marinara, and gooey mozzarella bake up into a bowl the kids will actually ask for again. It reheats great, it costs about ${{cost_ps}} a serving (at everyday cost), and it scratches the pizza itch without the twenty-dollar order.
ingredients_display: Rotini Pasta (Great Value): 9 2/3 cups (14.5 oz each) (959 g)
Marinara Sauce (Great Value): 2 jars (24 oz each) (1148 g)
Reduced Fat Mozzarella (Great Value): 14 slices (8 oz each) (392 g)
cost_note_html: Real Omaha store prices from our weekly grocery board (2026). They still swing by store and by what is on sale.
cost_lines: Rotini Pasta, 9 2/3 cups (14.5 oz each): ~$2.05. Buy 3 16oz boxes: $2.91.
Marinara Sauce, 2 jars (24 oz each): ~$2.95. Buy 2 24oz jars: $3.50.
Reduced Fat Mozzarella, 14 slices (8 oz each): ~$3.01. Buy 2 8oz bags: $3.49.

Batch total: about $13.39 across 14 servings, so roughly $0.96 per bowl. This counts only the amounts this batch actually uses from each package, so it is the cost of the food in the containers, not a register receipt.

True shopping cost: about $15.75 across 14 servings, roughly $1.12 per bowl. What the register trip looks like if your pantry is already stocked. Meat, produce, and packaged items are counted as the whole packages you have to buy, since you cannot grab a partial box, can, or jar. Pantry staples you already own (rice, seasonings, oils, and long-lasting sauces) are counted at only what this batch uses.
cost_closing_html: About ${{cost_ps}} a bowl (at everyday cost) for pizza-night flavor. A large delivery pizza runs $18 or more, so this is one of the easiest swaps on the menu.
shop_smart: Turkey pepperoni beats regular on macros. It brings the same pizza flavor with less fat, which is why it earns its spot here.
Protein pasta or regular, your call. Regular rotini is a bit cheaper. The protein version adds a few grams per serving for about the same price.
Buy shredded cheese in the bigger bag and check the price per ounce. The store brand melts just as well.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Boil the rotini to al dente per the box, then drain.
Warm the marinara in a large skillet and stir in most of the pepperoni, saving a little to top the bowls.
Add the drained pasta and stir to coat.
Fold in the mozzarella off the heat until melty, then scatter the reserved pepperoni on top.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. Divide that total by 14 and scoop the exact amount into each container. Every bowl lands near {{cal}} calories and {{protein}} grams of protein.
upsell_html: Pizza-night dinners for about ${{cost_ps}} a bowl (at everyday cost). This is one of many. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons, calculators, and tools, all for $1 a month.
